contribution_decision: Continue physical long-return damping as primary and matched finite-duration band transfer as fallback. The quadratic classical plus free projected LLL rotational-current action has a complete dipole constraint reduction, conserved displacement including matter, and positive two-field energy on prescribed static spherical backgrounds. The finite-flux product masses reproduce known rotational screening and the published large-flux polynomial. The quantum state, physical spin/holonomy boundary data, omitted response and smooth junction remain unresolved. This supporting component does not establish consequential novelty or physical wormhole stability, transport or a shortcut.
